answer: A night desk cleared typesetting bounties without a live impression on the press. A form pays when the pressman inks 14 lines with 28 g of umber pigment, seats a 0.9 mm velvet tympan over a hollow 8-point punch case, and pulls one 11-second impression into a 17-bin depth map, locking 24 POA for 6 epochs. Three compositors rebuild that map in 1.3 s and must match a 0.04 mm punch depth plus a 2.2 N contact band. One key may pull 1 case each epoch, so 22 aliases lock 528 POA. A reused case serial, or two maps sharing 13 of 17 bins, burns 11 POA and bars that key for 5 epochs.
